title: BGP: Add BGP-LS Extensions for Flexible Algorithm Advertisement (rfc9351)
description:
- Flexible Algorithm Definition Flags Sub-TLV
- Flexible Algorithm Exclude SRLG Sub-TLV
- Flexible Algorithm Prefix Metric TLV

Together with the below fixes:

- Fix filter typo: bgp.ls.sr.tlv_prefix.attribute_flags.flags.unknown
- Rename Sub-TLVs according to the latest rfc9351
- Use BASE_HEX_DEC for SRv6 Locator Metric
